name: customer-price-list
title: Your price list
for_each: select id,name from customers order by name

sections.title: Your prices today
sections.note: Prices exclude GST unless stated. Your agreed special prices are shown where they apply.
sections.sql: select sku,product,currency,entitled_cents as price_cents,basis from entitled_prices where customer_id=$1 order by sku

sections.title: Quantity breaks
sections.sql: select sku,name,min_qty,currency,price_cents from list_margins where price_list_id=(select price_list_id from customers where id=$1) and min_qty>1 order by sku,min_qty

sections.title: Special prices and end dates
sections.sql: select sku,product,currency,price_cents,valid_to from special_work where customer_id=$1 and status='approved' and valid_to>=current_date order by valid_to

name: recommended-retail-list
title: Recommended retail prices
for_each: select id,name from price_lists where recommended_retail order by code

sections.title: Recommended prices
sections.sql: select sku,name,currency,price_cents,case when gst_inclusive then 'including GST' else 'GST status not set' end as gst from list_margins where price_list_id=$1 and min_qty=1 order by sku

sections.title: Reseller statement
sections.sql: select coalesce(resale_statement,'Missing: add a statement that resellers set their own prices before issuing this list') as statement from price_lists where id=$1

name: price-change-brief
title: Price change brief
for_each: select id,name from price_changes where status in ('draft','approved') order by effective_on

sections.title: The change
sections.sql: select name,status,effective_on,uplift_bps,array_to_string(lists,', ') as lists,array_to_string(groups,', ') as groups,created_by,approved_by from price_changes where id=$1

sections.title: Lines and new margins
sections.sql: select list,sku,min_qty,currency,old_cents,new_cents,cost_cents,new_margin_bps,qty_12m from change_lines where change_id=$1 order by list,sku,min_qty

sections.title: Customer notices
sections.sql: select customer,rep,notice_days,notify_by,notified_on,notice_state from notice_work where change_id=$1 order by notify_by
